title: By Friday I’ll have finished

lines.en: By Friday I’ll have finished the budget, so the team will have everything it needs before the audit.
lines.pt: Até sexta eu terei terminado o orçamento, então a equipe terá tudo o que precisa antes da auditoria.

lines.en: Will you have sent the figures to the board by then, or will they have to wait until Monday?
lines.pt: Você já terá enviado os números ao conselho até lá, ou eles terão que esperar até segunda?

lines.en: They’ll have received them by noon on Thursday. By the end of the week I’ll have worked here for five years.
lines.pt: Eles terão recebido até o meio-dia de quinta. No fim da semana terei completado cinco anos aqui.

lines.en: Five years already! By next spring I’ll have asked for a raise, and maybe I’ll even have been promoted.
lines.pt: Já cinco anos! Até a próxima primavera eu terei pedido um aumento, e talvez até tenha sido promovido.

lines.en: Good plan. Will you have prepared your presentation by the time the director comes back from Sydney?
lines.pt: Bom plano. Você terá preparado sua apresentação até a diretora voltar de Sydney?

lines.en: I hope so. By then we’ll have signed the new contract, and the client will have approved the schedule.
lines.pt: Espero que sim. Até lá teremos assinado o novo contrato, e o cliente terá aprovado o cronograma.

lines.en: Not if the lawyers keep changing the deadline. By the time they decide, we’ll have lost two weeks.
lines.pt: Não se os advogados continuarem mudando o prazo. Quando decidirem, teremos perdido duas semanas.

lines.en: True. By this time next month the project will have become larger, and we’ll have hired three more people.
lines.pt: Verdade. Daqui a um mês o projeto terá crescido, e teremos contratado mais três pessoas.

lines.en: Will you have trained them by the summer? I will not have finished my own work by then.
lines.pt: Você os terá treinado até o verão? Eu não terei terminado meu próprio trabalho até lá.

lines.en: I’ll have done my best, at least. By the end of the year we’ll have saved a lot of money.
lines.pt: Terei feito o meu melhor, pelo menos. Até o fim do ano teremos economizado muito dinheiro.

lines.en: Let’s hope so. By the time we leave tonight, we’ll have solved at least one problem!
lines.pt: Vamos torcer. Quando sairmos hoje à noite, teremos resolvido pelo menos um problema!

facts.label: Futuro perfeito
facts.sub: Concluído até um momento futuro: By Friday I’ll have finished. Pergunta: Will you have sent it? Negativa: I won’t have finished. Marcador: by + tempo.

facts.label: Até (prazo)
facts.sub: By marca o limite do prazo: by Friday, by noon, by the end of the year. By the time + oração também funciona: By the time they decide, we’ll have lost two weeks. Não use until aqui.

facts.label: Will you have…?
facts.sub: Para perguntar: Will you have sent the figures by then? Forma: Will + sujeito + have + particípio. Resposta curta: Yes, I will. / No, I won’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Will have + participle shows an action finished before a future time.

items.why: It means not later than Friday.

items.s: “By the time they decide, we’ll have lost two weeks” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Will have + participle shows an action finished before a future time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
By Friday means after Friday. → Falso (It means not later than Friday.)
“By the time they decide, we’ll have lost two weeks” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.why: We say I will have finished it.

items.s: The negative is won’t have + participle.

pages.title: A busy week at the office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a busy Melbourne office. Dario has a long task list. The audit is next week, and the budget is not ready. His colleague Rui brings two coffees. The board wants the figures soon. They talk about the next few months.

“By Friday I’ll have finished the budget, so the team will have everything it needs before the audit.” says Dario. “Will you have sent the figures to the board by then, or will they have to wait until Monday?” says Rui. “They’ll have received them by noon on Thursday. By the end of the week I’ll have worked here for five years.” says Dario.

solo: Aluno diz o que aprendeu e lê a tarefa.
group: Recapitule 3 coisas aprendidas.
Tarefa: Write 5 sentences about what you will have done by the end of the year. Use will have + participle.
Pergunta de adaptação: Em outra situação, um detalhe mudou. Como você se adaptaria?
extra90: Correção coletiva (3 min): mostre 3 a 5 frases anotadas na pausa e nos trios, sem expor o autor; o grupo corrige antes de você.
Use a lista “Correções frequentes” abaixo para os erros típicos desta aula.

errors.w: By Friday I’ll finished the report.
errors.r: By Friday I’ll have finished the report.

errors.w: She will have wrote it by noon.
errors.r: She will have written it by noon.

errors.w: By next year I will have to work here five years.
errors.r: By next year I will have worked here for five years.

errors.r: By Friday I’ll have finished the report.
